# Airscale API

> Airscale product guides, integration workflows, MCP documentation, and public API reference.
> Preview documentation is intentionally noindex. Use only the airscale.mintlify.app links in this file.

## API Reference — Start here

- [API Overview](https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/api-overview.md): Authenticate with Airscale and make your first API request.
- [Authentication](https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/authentication.md): Create, send, protect, and rotate an Airscale API key.
- [Rate limits](https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/rate-limits.md): Understand endpoint-specific request limits and 429 responses.

## API Reference — Search and discovery

- [Find people](https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/find-people.md): Search people using person, role, and company filters.
- [Count people](https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/find-people/count.md): Count people matching person, role, and company filters.
- [Find companies](https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/find-companies.md): Search companies using firmographic, location, event, intent, and technology filters.
- [Company filter values](https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/find-companies/filter-values.md): Search supported values for Find Companies filters.
- [Airsearch](https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/airsearch.md): Research the web and return structured answers with Airsearch.

## API Reference — Contact data

- [Email finder](https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/email-finder.md): Find a professional email address for one person.
- [Bulk email finder](https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/email-finder-(bulk).md): Find professional email addresses for a batch of people.
- [Mobile finder](https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/mobile-finder.md): Find a mobile phone number from a professional profile.
- [Personal email](https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/personal-email.md): Find a personal email address from a professional profile.
- [People URL finder](https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/people-url-finder.md): Find a professional profile URL from person and company details.

## API Reference — Profiles and reverse lookup

- [People profile](https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/extract-people-profile.md): Extract a structured person profile from a professional profile URL.
- [Company profile](https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/extract-company-profile.md): Extract a structured company profile from a company profile URL.
- [Reverse email](https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/reverse-email.md): Find a person profile from an email address.
- [Reverse phone](https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/reverse-phone.md): Find a person profile from a phone number.

## API Reference — Account

- [Credit count](https://airscale.mintlify.app/api-reference/credit-count.md): Check the remaining credit balance for your Airscale workspace.

## MCP & Agents — Start

- [Build with Airscale MCP](https://airscale.mintlify.app/mcp/airscale-mcp-server.md): Connect AI clients and agents to Airscale search, enrichment, research, and export tools.
- [MCP tool catalog](https://airscale.mintlify.app/mcp/tools.md): Browse all 22 typed tools exposed by the Airscale MCP server.

## MCP & Agents — Connect

- [Connect Airscale MCP to ChatGPT](https://airscale.mintlify.app/mcp/connect-airscale-mcp-to-chatgpt.md): Connect ChatGPT to Airscale through browser OAuth and validate the connection without spending credits.
- [Connect Airscale MCP to Claude](https://airscale.mintlify.app/mcp/connect-airscale-mcp-to-claude.md): Connect Claude clients to Airscale with hosted OAuth or a protected Claude Code authorization header.

## MCP & Agents — Use

- [Use the Airscale MCP](https://airscale.mintlify.app/mcp/how-to-use-the-airscale-mcp.md): Follow a free-first, bounded workflow for Airscale MCP searches, enrichment, and asynchronous exports.

## MCP & Agents — For agents

- [Agent resources](https://airscale.mintlify.app/mcp/agent-resources.md): Find the human-readable and machine-readable Airscale references intended for AI agents.

## Machine-readable contracts

- [OpenAPI specification](https://airscale.mintlify.app/openapi.json): HTTP API operations, schemas, authentication, and responses.
- [MCP tool catalog](https://airscale.mintlify.app/mcp/tools.md): Hosted Markdown with names, input schemas, credit behavior, examples, and API mappings for all 22 operational MCP tools.
- [Agent skill](https://airscale.mintlify.app/skill.md): Capability, authentication, credit, and approval guidance for agents.
